meta.title: No Counter Offer on a bid the buyer entered for the vendor
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: No Counter Offer for Surrogate Bid

steps.note: Open the prepared comparison view containing the vendor's existing bid.
Enter the second bid on behalf of another invited vendor so the comparison includes a surrogate bid.
Verify the comparison shows one direct vendor response and one surrogate response.
Attempt a Counter Offer on the surrogate bid; the action must be refused because surrogate bids cannot receive counter offers.
Open Settings and verify Bulk Counter Offer is not offered when not all bids can receive counter offers.
